description: Run read-only Shipcheck static analysis on an authorized local JavaScript, TypeScript, or MCP repository. Use before launch, directory submission, or client handoff to find exposed environment values, unsigned webhook handlers, missing database-rule evidence, debug leftovers, dependency risk, weak CI/docs, and usage-cost guardrail gaps. The tool reads project files, does not modify the repository, does not execute project code, and does not require network access. It returns both a formatted report and structured findings with severity, file path, and remediation.

failOn.description: Pass/fail threshold. high fails only high findings; medium fails medium and high; low fails low through high; info fails on any finding.

format.description: Report rendering: text for terminals, markdown for review notes, json for automation, or sarif for code-scanning upload.

root.description: Absolute or relative path to the authorized local repository. Defaults to the current working directory.

strict.description: When true, enables extra release-readiness checks for launch handoff, directory submission, and production review.

name: scan_repository

failOn.description: Severity threshold used for the pass/fail decision.

file.description: Relative file path tied to the finding, when available.

ok.description: Whether the scan passed the selected failOn threshold.

title: Scan repository with Shipcheck
